description: Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance on 10 F/A-18C aircraft electrical systems and related equipment.
Promoted to Work Center Training Petty Officer April 2012. Maintain training records for over 19 personnel.
Consistently volunteer to assist in aircraft maintenance regardless of the difficulty.
Handled customers effectively by identifying needs, quickly gaining trust, approaching complex situations and resolving problems to maximize efficiency.
Up-sold additional menu items, beverages, and desserts to increase restaurant profits.

matchmaking_summary: The candidate presents a robust background in customer service, electronics maintenance, and organizational skills. With expertise in both front-facing roles such as the Customer Service Representative and technical roles like Aviation Electrician, they demonstrate adaptability and dedication across various settings. Their ability to handle high-volume environments efficiently showcases strong multitasking and problem-solving capabilities. The candidate's commitment to professionalism and continuous learning aligns well with a dynamic customer service role.
